summary: Lionheart Holdings (a SPAC) filed an 8-K disclosing it will enter into Non-Redemption Agreements with unaffiliated shareholders to reduce redemptions at the June 15, 2026 extraordinary general meeting, which seeks to extend the deadline to complete a business combination to March 20, 2027. In exchange for not redeeming Class A ordinary shares, the Sponsor will transfer Class B ordinary shares (expected ratio of one Class B per five Non-Redeemed Shares) post-business combination. The filing does not specify price, premium, or advisor. This is an ad hoc redemption reduction mechanism, not a standard special situation, so category is Other.
